title: ENDEX: Wednesday 11:00, Import Held, One Set of Numbers

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is 11:00 on Wednesday, October 7, 2026. Under the plan, the imported 500 mL lot IMP-2609-114 may go to units only after the full substitution checklist, the second pharmacist check, nurse education and the Friday pump library build. Allocation is still 40% and conservation is in force. This ends the exercise. Please keep your status boards, draft messages, checklists and metrics, and move to the hot wash.
finalState: Clock: 11:00, Wednesday, October 7, 2026. Play stops here.
Under the plan, lot IMP-2609-114 goes to units only after the full checklist, the second pharmacist check, nurse education and the Friday pump library build.
Allocation stays at 40% and conservation stays in force until confirmed deliveries raise days on hand. Usable NS 1000 mL was at 4.3 days on hand at the 07:00 recount.
What the room actually did about the 6 West event, the FDA and Iowa Board of Pharmacy notifications, the P&T written report and the 11:30 update is for the hot wash to establish.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down the phones and the printouts. Take ten minutes, then come back to Conference Room C and we will start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well and three things that broke. Each role gives one item from each list, then we take open discussion.
hotWashQuestions: When did we make the Level 3 call, and which numbers drove it: the 07:00 system figure, the 08:20 recount or the quarantined lot?
Did we give out the scarce 1000 mL NS by clinical priority, and was that fair? Think about the ED septic patient, the Chair 4 chemo hydration and the Wednesday elective deferrals.
How did the imported 500 mL bags reach 6 West before the substitution checklist and the pump library entry? What control should have stopped them at the dock?
Did every unit, the medical staff and the public get one set of numbers? Compare the 6 West and ICU flush memos, the Patient Relations script and the media responses.

Did every required notice go out on time, and did each one have the same figures? That means the FDA, the Iowa Board of Pharmacy, the state public health request, the Webster Valley loan form and the internal safety event report.
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect all status boards, draft messages and the substitution checklists before the break. Note any role that lost track of the 1,120 bag recount or the 890 quarantined bags.

instructorNote: This card ends play and moves the room into the hot wash. Make sure every role speaks on these topics: when the Level 3 call was made, allocation by clinical priority, the imported bags reaching units before the checklist, the 6 West event, message consistency and whether all notifications went out. Record improvement items for the after-action report.
